proof_body:
by
  intro c R hR
  have e : Set.EqOn (fun z : ℂ => (starRingEnd ℂ) z) (fun z => (starRingEnd ℂ) c + (R : ℂ) ^ 2 * (z - c)⁻¹) (Metric.sphere c R) := by
    intro z hz
    have hn : ‖z - c‖ = R := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    have hne : z - c ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← norm_pos_iff, hn]; exact hR
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) (z - c) * (z - c) = (R : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Complex.conj_mul', hn]
    simp only
    field_simp
    rw [map_sub] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr hR.le e]
  have i1 : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => (starRingEnd ℂ) c) c R := circleIntegrable_const _ _ _
  have i2 : CircleIntegrable (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) ^ 2 * (z - c)⁻¹) c R := by
    have := (circleIntegrable_sub_inv_iff (c := c) (w := c) (R := R)).mpr (Or.inr (by simp [abs_of_pos hR, hR.ne]))
    exact this.const_fun_smul (a := (R : ℂ) ^ 2)
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_add i1 i2, circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, circleIntegral.integral_sub_center_inv c hR.ne']
  have : (∮ _ in C(c, R), (starRingEnd ℂ) c) = 0 := by
    apply circleIntegral.integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivWithinAt' (f := fun z => (starRingEnd ℂ) c * z)
    intro z _
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul ((starRingEnd ℂ) c)).hasDerivWithinAt
  rw [this]; ring
target_source: ∀ (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → (∮ z in C(c, R), (starRingEnd ℂ) z) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (R : ℂ) ^ 2
